logo_override.alt_text: Mandela Washington Fellowship for Young African Leaders
logo_override.validation_detail: png 848x186, probed HTTP 200 with content-type image/png. Rendered on a white background and visually confirmed as the full programme lockup: the roundel device beside 'MANDELA WASHINGTON FELLOWSHIP' over 'FOR YOUNG AFRICAN LEADERS' in the programme's cyan, with the strapline in dark navy. Pixel analysis: 74.2% transparent, nearWhite 11.6%, nearBlack 0.0%, mean opaque rgb(60,171,218) - the artwork is cyan-on-transparent, not white, so it is legible on a light card.
logo_override._award: Mandela Washington Fellowship for Young African Leaders (2027 Fellowship)

notes: The awarding body is the U.S. Department of State (Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs), which funds the programme, with IREX as administrator; mandelawashingtonfellowship.org is the programme's own official site, so its programme lockup is the correct mark for this record rather than an outside party's. WordPress site on the shared 'yali' theme. The header logo is a CSS background rather than an img, so I enumerated computed background-image values across the header and got the theme's asset paths, then read the theme's own stylesheet app.css to enumerate every logo file it ships: logo-white.svg, logo-dark.svg, logo-white.png, logo-dark.png, logo-submittable.png, header-logo1.png, footer-logo-1/3/4.png. The trap here is naming: despite the name, logo-dark.svg is NOT a dark variant - its fills are fill="#29abe2" plus repeated fill="#fff", identical to logo-white.svg, i.e. both are for dark backgrounds. Rejected logo-white.svg (19861 bytes) and logo-white.png (307x65, 66.8% transparent, 57.7% near-white) under rule 3. Reported logo-dark.png instead, whose PNG bytes are demonstrably cyan rather than white and which renders correctly on white. Also rejected: header-logo1.png (only 71x36, too small), footer-logo-1.png (64x33), footer-logo-4.png (156x63 but green-toned and clearly a partner variant), logo-submittable.png (122x122, orange, not the programme lockup), the theme's apple-icon.png (192x192 but that is the generic theme/YALI mark) and safari-pinned-tab.svg (a monochrome black mask silhouette, not the wordmark). department-of-state-seal.svg is present in the header but I did not report it: a government seal used as a co-brand partner mark, not the fellowship's own identity. Probed and 404: logo.svg, logo-color.svg, logo-cyan.svg, logo-black.svg, logo-blue.svg, logo-color.png, logo1.png, header-logo.png, logo-mobile.png, mobile-logo.png, footer-logo.png, header-logo2.png, header-logo3.png.
